data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Maia is a goddess of motherhood, fertility, and growth. The name Maye is derived from Maia, and it signifies a deep and nurturing love, as well as the potential for growth and prosperity. The name Maye carries the meaning “Mother's love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maye usually hope their child will grow to embody mother's love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine love and nurturing care of the Mother Goddess.
data.etymology: Maye belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother's love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maye total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Maye is of Greek origin and has been used in various cultures throughout history, particularly among Christians. It carries a strong association with the Greek goddess Maia, who was revered for her nurturing abilities and was believed to have the power to grant prosperity and growth. This cultural background has influenced the way we perceive and value the name Maye, connecting it to ideas of motherhood, love, and support.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Maye carries a deeper spiritual significance. It represents the loving and caring nature of God, who provides us with the nurturing and protection we need to grow and thrive. In addition, Maye is a reminder of the importance of love and support in our spiritual lives. Just as a mother nurtures and loves her child, so too does God love and care for us unconditionally. This spiritual significance is a powerful reminder of the depth and breadth of God's love and compassion.
